attrs.en: The hollow-fiber membrane module from the side. Culture from the pump enters the fiber lumens on the left and leaves on the right through the pinch valve that clamps the end of the lumen tube; liquid that crosses the fiber walls joins the shell loop, which runs from the Out-Shell port back to the In-Shell port, and leaves by the loop's branch to the harvest line. Four pressure gauges, each behind a filter, read the In-Shell and Out-Shell ports above and the In-Lumen and Out-Lumen ports below. A planned droplet sensor lies under the whole setup. The buttons above play four situations; the alarm lights below say which planned alarm catches each.
attrs.zh: 中空纖維膜模組的側視圖。來自幫浦的培養液從左側進入纖維管腔，再從右側經由夾住管腔管末端的夾管閥離開；穿過纖維壁的液體匯入殼側迴路，該迴路由 Out-Shell 接口回到 In-Shell 接口，並由迴路的分支流向收穫管線。四個壓力計各裝在一個濾膜之後，上方讀取 In-Shell 與 Out-Shell 接口，下方讀取 In-Lumen 與 Out-Lumen 接口。整組裝置下方有一個規劃中的液滴感測器。上方的按鈕會播放四種情況；下方的警報燈指出每一種情況由哪一個規劃中的警報攔下。

attrs.en: Drive chain. Software sets a duty cycle for each tier; the Arduino's PWM pins run along a bus to three MOSFETs, one per intensity tier; each MOSFET switches a green and a red column of four matched LEDs. Three tiers across two wavelengths give six light conditions.

attrs.en: Line chart: the freeboard the assembled plate floats at against the mass it carries, computed from the STLs. At zero mass the line starts at 25.1 millimetres, the full height of the hull. It falls about 1 millimetre for every 3.5 grams to 9.2 millimetres at 54.2 grams, the waterline of the section drawing above, then a little more slowly, through about 4.8 millimetres at 71.3 grams, the assembled plate before seedlings, to 3.2 millimetres at 79.4 grams, where the underside of the slab meets the water. From there it falls about 1 millimetre for every 10 grams, to nothing at 111.9 grams, when the top of the slab is awash. Printed in solid PLA, the sixteen parts would weigh at most 92.6 grams and float at 1.9 millimetres.
attrs.zh: 折線圖：由 STL 檔算出的，組裝完成的浮板在各承載質量下的乾舷。質量為零時，線由 25.1 公釐起算，也就是殼體的全高。每增加 3.5 公克約下降 1 公釐，到 54.2 公克時為 9.2 公釐，即上方剖面圖中的水線；之後下降略慢，經過 71.3 公克時的約 4.8 公釐，即尚未放入幼苗、組裝完成的浮板，再到 79.4 公克時的 3.2 公釐，此時板身下緣正好接觸水面。從這裡起，每增加 10 公克約下降 1 公釐，到 111.9 公克時降為零，板身頂面被水淹過。若十六個零件全以實心 PLA 列印，最重為 92.6 公克，浮起時乾舷為 1.9 公釐。

attrs.en: Plan view drawn from the CAD. The plate is 117.50 by 92.50 millimetres. Thirteen teardrop-shaped bores sit in rows of four, five and four, 21.59 millimetres apart along a row. A sealed air chamber, shaded violet, lies hidden below each long side, inside a pontoon drawn dashed, and a clip-in handle sits at each end. Section A–A crosses the plate through the outer-row bores.
attrs.zh: 依 CAD 繪製的俯視圖。浮板為 117.50 × 92.50 公釐。十三個水滴形孔分成 4、5、4 三排，同一排間距 21.59 公釐。每一條長邊下方都隱藏著一個以紫色標示的密封氣室，位在以虛線繪製的浮筒之內，兩端各有一個卡入式把手。A–A 剖面通過外排的孔橫切浮板。

attrs.en: Section A–A drawn from the CAD: a 3.18 millimetre slab carried by a pontoon along each long side, a sealed air chamber inside each pontoon, two seed holders in their bores, and nothing underneath the middle of the plate. Overall height 25.08 millimetres.
attrs.zh: 依 CAD 繪製的 A–A 剖面：3.18 公釐厚的板身，由兩條長邊各一的浮筒支撐，每個浮筒內有一個密封氣室，兩個種子座插在孔中，浮板中段下方則是空的。總高 25.08 公釐。

attrs.en: The plate afloat, in section. Its mass, made up of the plate, the seedlings and any water the print takes on, pulls it down; buoyancy from the medium displaced by the two pontoons acts up. The plate settles where the two balance, at a freeboard that keeps the crowns above the medium and the roots in it.
attrs.zh: 浮板浮於液面的剖面。它的質量（浮板本身、幼苗，以及列印件吸入的水）把它往下拉；兩條浮筒排開培養液所產生的浮力把它往上推。浮板停在兩者平衡之處，此時的乾舷讓植株冠部露在培養液上方，根則留在培養液中。
